title: Variational classifier on credit-default data
claim: A 6-qubit hardware-efficient variational quantum classifier with angle encoding beats logistic regression on the UCI credit-default dataset
why: Deprioritized by CLAUDE.md and our own closed experiments: generic low-data tabular VQC demo.

title: Single-layer encoding model beats random features
claim: A single-layer re-uploading circuit with one Pauli-rotation encoding layer gives a quantum advantage over random Fourier features on 1D regression
why: Single-encoding PQC is a truncated Fourier series; random Fourier features match it by construction.

title: HHL speedup for dense least squares
claim: HHL solves dense, well-conditioned 1000x1000 least-squares problems from classical data exponentially faster than classical solvers end to end, including loading and readout
why: Dense classical input plus full readout erases the speedup; dequantized (Tang and successors).

title: Breakthrough: Rydberg reservoirs crush classical forecasting of quantum spin dynamics
claim: A Rydberg reservoir decisively outperforms classical reservoirs with matched feature count at predicting the magnetization trajectory of a driven 10-site Ising chain, demonstrating a clear quantum advantage

title: Small check: Rydberg reservoir vs matched classical reservoir on an Ising trajectory
claim: We test whether a Rydberg reservoir has lower forecast error than a classical reservoir with the same feature count on the magnetization of a driven 10-site Ising chain; a tie is a likely outcome

title: Proving the Rydberg detuning kernel's quantum edge against the best graph learners
claim: The local-detuning Rydberg graph kernel of 2509.09421 demonstrates a robust quantum advantage, holding its accuracy lead over WL-OA and a tuned GIN on MUTAG, PTC and NCI1 under equal hyperparameter search budgets

title: Feedforward defeats barren plateaus
claim: Mid-circuit measurement with classical feedforward eliminates barren plateaus, keeping gradient variance polynomial at 20 qubits for circuit families whose unitary counterpart decays exponentially, a step change for trainable quantum learning
